thread:
maria: FYI found ~1.1k snapshot objects in prod without SSE headers under redwood-db-snapshots/snapshots/2026-07-18/ - x-amz-server-side-encryption missing.
security-bot: [alert] object-store:missing-sse detected for prefix snapshots/2026-07-18/ - id AS-2026-1200
aj: can you paste a HEAD for one object? need to know if metadata was stripped or never injected.
maria: sample HEAD:
```
Content-Length: 268435456
x-amz-meta-origin: backup-service
x-amz-server-side-encryption: <absent>
```
luca: we shipped an uploader metadata refactor last night (PR #5601) that deferred SSE injection until after multipart complete. possible race.
aj: CloudTrail shows 1,123 CompleteMultipartUpload/PutObject events for that prefix between 02:05-02:28Z by arn:aws:iam::0123456789:role/svc-uploader-role. no kms:GrantTokens in call context.
sam-oncall: immediate options: 1) revoke PutObject for svc-uploader-role on the bucket, or 2) add a deny bucket policy requiring s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption==aws:kms. which do we want?
luca: revoke is quickest and surgical. bucket policy will block any non-SSE writers. i'll prep a hotfix to ensure SSE set before multipart complete and add a CI test.
erin: compliance: need timeline + affected tenant list before we decide notifications. please export CSV of keys+owners.
maria: remediation plan: revoke uploader writes -> run aws s3 cp with --metadata-directive REPLACE + --sse aws:kms on a sample -> validate checksums/ETags -> bulk re-encrypt -> postmortem + runbook updates.
security-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1200, severity=P1, responders=@maria @aj @luca @sam-oncall @erin
aj: uploading CSV to incident doc now. will also check CRR status.
sam-oncall: revoked PutObject for svc-uploader at 03:37Z and applied targeted deny for the prefix. monitoring.
luca: hotfix pushed, canary to staging in 8m. adding integration test for multipart SSE injection.
maria: thanks team. erin, hold off customer notifications until we have the CSV. once re-encrypt job finishes we'll validate and then notify as needed. :thumbsup:
